name: chip
title: Chip
description: Pills the user picks or removes: filters, a single choice, or values they entered.

examples.name: chip-demo
examples.title: Chip
examples.description: Filter chips with counts. "All" turns on when nothing else is.

examples.name: chip-choice
examples.title: Choice
examples.description: mode="choice": exactly one on, like a period picker that wraps.

examples.name: chip-input
examples.title: Input
examples.description: mode="input": entered values with a remove button; Delete or Backspace removes the focused chip.

examples.name: chip-with-icons
examples.title: Icons and avatars
examples.description: A leading icon gives way to the check when selected; an avatar is covered by a check disc.

examples.name: chip-sizes
examples.title: Sizes and one row
examples.description: md (the control height) and sm, and wrap={false} for a single row that scrolls, with a disabled chip.

examples.name: chip-family
examples.title: Badge, Tag, PersonChip or Chip
examples.description: Badge = a state or count. Tag = a static attribute. PersonChip = a person. Chip = something the user picks or removes.

props.name: mode
props.description: filter = any number on (multiple selection) with a check on selected chips; choice = exactly one on (single selection, can't be emptied); input = removable values, not selectable (needs onRemove).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the chips. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the control height (40px comfortable, 32px compact), the same as a Button or TextField; sm is one 8px step smaller.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap onto more lines, or (false) keep one row that scrolls sideways.

props.name: selectedKeys / defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Controlled or initial selection (filter and choice modes).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when chips are turned on or off.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: input mode: called with the keys to remove (the remove button, Delete or Backspace).

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Chips that can't be focused, toggled or removed.

props.name: items
props.description: Items for a dynamic collection; children is then a function that renders one Chip.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no chips (e.g. every input chip was removed).

props.name: id
props.description: The chip's key in selection and onRemove.

props.name: children
props.description: The label: one to three words.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon from @syntara/icons. Decorative. In filter mode the check takes its place when selected.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A leading Avatar (pass alt=""). Sized to the chip; in filter mode a brand check disc covers it when selected.

props.name: count
props.description: A quiet trailing number, formatted for the locale and read as part of the chip's name ("Sponsored 3").

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain-text name when children isn't a string. The count is appended.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables this chip (same as listing it in disabledKeys).

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the group (to the last focused chip), then (input mode) to that chip's remove button, then out.
Moves between chips (flipped in RTL). Disabled chips are skipped.
filter: turns the focused chip on or off. choice: selects it (the selected chip stays on).

notes: A React Aria TagGroup: role="grid" named by the label (or aria-label), each chip a row with aria-selected in filter and choice modes; filter mode sets aria-multiselectable.
A chip's accessible name is its label plus its count ("Sponsored 3"), in the user's number format.
Selection isn't carried by colour alone: selected chips turn medium weight, filter chips show a check, and forced-colours mode draws a Highlight edge.
Remove buttons are named "Remove <label>" in the user's language and keep a 24px target at every size and density.
Icons, avatars and the check are decorative (aria-hidden or alt="").
Motion (pop-in, press spring, check draw-in, the check slot opening) is off with reduced motion; colours and the check still fade.

do: Use filter chips to narrow a list, choice chips for one option among a few, input chips for values the user typed or picked.
Keep labels to one to three words; add a count when it helps people choose.
Use wrap={false} for a filter row on narrow screens, and keep the first chips the most used.
dont: Don't use a Chip for a status or count on its own (Badge), a static attribute (Tag) or a person (PersonChip).
Don't use chips to navigate between pages; use Tabs or links.
Don't mix modes in one group or put more than about ten chips in a row.

typeNotes.note: Called with a Selection: 'all' or a Set<Key>. Import the type from @syntara/react. onRemove gets a plain Set<Key>.
